description.value: This Campbell River establishment operates as a combined pub (19+), family restaurant, and liquor store under the name MVP Pub and Family Restaurant. The pub side pours beer on tap including a house brew, serves cocktails in frosted mugs, and hosts a pool table, keno, and sports viewing; a quieter restaurant section shares the full menu. Cyclists seeking a sit-down meal or a cold beer after a ride will find an all-week kitchen with rotating specials.

address.value: 489 Dogwood St S, Campbell River, British Columbia

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at mvppub.ca consistently identifies the business as 'MVP Pub and Family Restaurant' at 489 Dogwood St S, Campbell River, BC, phone (250) 286-4944 — a significant name mismatch with the OSM entry 'Merecroft Pub'. The site's 2026 copyright and current hours confirm the business is actively open. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site; the only diet-related evidence is the menu page noting 'gluten-friendly items' prepared in a common kitchen.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM lists this as 'Merecroft Pub' but the website consistently uses 'MVP Pub and Family Restaurant' — the OSM record may be outdated or matched to a former business name at this address.
OSM record contains no phone or address; both values were sourced solely from the website.
Website URL was autodiscovered (not in OSM tags); the name mismatch warrants manual verification that mvppub.ca corresponds to this exact OSM location.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating pub, family restaurant, and liquor store in Campbell River — a practical stop for touring cyclists despite the OSM name discrepancy.
